meta.name: smart-commit
meta.description: Run quality gates, review staged changes for issues, and create a well-crafted conventional commit. Use when saying "commit", "git commit", "save my changes", or ready to commit after making changes.

copy.tagline: 自动检查代码质量并生成规范提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次提交前都想自动检查代码并生成规范的提交信息。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically check code quality and generate conventional commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automated quality checks and conventional commit messages before every commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会检查代码质量、审查暂存文件中的问题，然后生成规范的 Git 提交信息，并询问你从这次改动中学到了什么。
howto.when: 当你说“commit”、“git commit”、“save my changes”或准备提交改动时触发。

say.note: Claude 会运行质量检查并生成提交信息。
Claude 会按文件名暂存指定文件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will run quality gates, review staged changes for issues, generate a conventional commit message, and ask what you learned from the change.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "commit", "git commit", "save my changes", or are ready to commit after making changes.

say_en.note: Claude will run quality checks and generate a commit message.
Claude will stage specific files by name.
